description: Overrides the project's breathing strength for as long as it lasts. Draws nothing; it only changes how deeply the frame moves and where it moves towards. Use it to open a section up, to hold a section still without switching the effect off everywhere, or to pull the breath onto a face instead of the middle of the frame.

fields.name: strength
fields.label: Strength
fields.description: How deep the breath is over this stretch. The tempo never changes; every strength shares one clock so the footage and the graphics stay in step.

fields.name: rect
fields.label: Where it pulls
fields.description: The breath pulls towards the middle of this box and never crops past its edges. Drag it to move the pull off centre; shrink it below about nine tenths of the frame and it starts capping the strength as well.
